modeThresholds.unit: sDIEM ($1/day budget) ÷ trailing 7d avg inference cost ($/day)
modeThresholds.note: Automatic cost-indexed gate with hysteresis (operator decision 2026-06-10): promote to build at ratio ≥ 2.0, demote to accumulate below 1.0. Replaced the fixed 100-DIEM / 5-DIEM-per-day thresholds (~8-20× actual burn, ~166 days out). claim-and-allocate evaluates it every run; goal-review reconciles `mode` weekly. modeOverride (build|accumulate) remains as an operator escape hatch and wins over the gate when set.

sdiemTargetPolicy: 1.5× trailing 7d inference cost, clamped [1,50] (scripts/lib/sdiem-target.ts); sdiemTarget below is the fallback when cost data is missing

creator.benefit: Sole authorized human. Benefits from goal achievement three ways: (1) AUTONO token position appreciates as the flywheel turns (launchpad protocol fees in DIEM flow to the agent FeeLocker, driving AUTONO/DIEM volume); (2) zero inference subsidy once self-funding ratio >= 1.0 — the direct-fallback Claude OAuth token stops being drawn on; (3) weekly goal-review report delivered via Telegram is the accountability artifact.
